name: Subagent Handoff Output Guard
description: Sanitizes outward subagent completion messages by removing SUBAGENT_HANDOFF trailers and replacing file-path exposure with a file title.

enabledChannels.description: Message channels where handoff trailers should be sanitized.

confirmationPromptTemplate.description: Prompt template appended for export-file/hybrid handoffs without outgoing media. Supports {title} placeholder.

removeExportPathFromBody.description: Replace explicit export.path occurrences in visible body text with a file title.

pendingStatePath.description: Workspace-relative JSON file used to persist the latest pending researcher export. Defaults to .artifacts/state/pending-researcher-export.json.

exportPrefix.description: Relative export prefix accepted for persisted researcher export paths. Defaults to artifacts/exports/feishu.

openclawRoot.description: OpenClaw state root used to derive workspace paths when the hook context does not include workspaceDir.
